notes: No more silent location fallback. Opening /client without an Instance ID used to fall back to the shared sites/auto-01 record, so a viewer with no ?id= silently showed whichever machine wrote that record last - two locations could display each other's queue. The viewer now shows a 'No location selected' panel with a field to paste an Instance ID, remembered on that device. /display is removed (404); the TV board still ships as display_with_ads.html, which is what the desktop app opens. Also: the queue grid now rebuilds when Settings changes the layout (adding a brand or cars no longer needs a page reload), cloud reads always send ?id=, and malformed instance IDs are rejected with a 400 instead of returning an empty board that looked like data loss.
